title: LIMITATIONS OF PINNED AUC FOR MEASURING UNINTENDED BIAS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical validity and limitations of a metric (Pinned AUC) for measuring unintended bias in classification models. While bias detection has ethical implications, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary subject. It is about the metric itself, not the ethical content of the models or data, beyond the presence of bias.
